title: Rapid Generation of Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells from Mouse Pre-B Cells
protocol: To prepare B cell medium, mix 88.9ml RPMI with L-Glutamine 1X, 10ml fetal bovine serum, 1ml penicillin-streptomycin 100X, and 100μl β-mercaptoethanol.
Add 100μl interleukin 7 1000X to the B cell medium.
Store the B cell medium at 4°C for up to two weeks.
To prepare N2B27 medium, mix 231ml DMEM/F12 and 231ml neurobasal medium.

Add 5ml penicillin-streptomycin 100X, 500μl β-mercaptoethanol 1000X, 5ml sodium pyruvate 100X, 5ml NE-aminoacids 100X, 5ml N2 supplement 100X, 10ml B27 supplement 50X, 500μl interleukin 7 1000X, 1000μl interleukin 4 500X, and 100μl interleukin 15 5000X.
From day 2 onwards, supplement N2B27 medium with 20% KSR, 3uM CHIR99021, and 1uM PD0325901.
Prepare the reprogramming medium without inducer and add doxycycline when needed.
To prepare OP9/S17 cell medium, mix 89ml DMEM with 20% fetal bovine serum and 1ml penicillin-streptomycin 100X.
Add 100μl β-mercaptoethanol 1000X to the mixture.
To prepare a 10μg/ml interleukin solution, mix 10μg interleukin with deionized water in a total volume of 1ml.
To prepare a 1mM β-Estradiol solution (10,000X), mix 272ug β-Estradiol with EtOH to make a final volume of 1ml.
Mix Doxycycline 50mg with deionized water 1ml to prepare a 50mg/ml solution.
Mix PBS 1X 240ml, FBS 10ml, and EDTA 0.5M 1ml to prepare labeling buffer.
Sacrifice two 8-16 week old reprogrammable mice by ventilating them with CO₂.
Remove femurs and tibiae aseptically from the mice.
Use scissors to remove all tissues from the bones.
Crush the bones in a mortar in 10 ml of labeling buffer.
Thoroughly resuspend the cells by pipetting them up and down.
Filter the cells through a 40μm cell strainer into a 50ml conical tube.
Centrifuge the cells for 5 minutes at 300xg, then resuspend in fresh labeling buffer and count them in a hemocytometer.
Resuspend the cells in labeling buffer to achieve a concentration of 10X10⁶ cells/ml.
Add Fc-block to the cell suspension at a concentration of 0.1μg/10⁶ cells and incubate for 10 minutes on ice.
Add CD19-biotin conjugated antibody (0.2ug/10⁶ cells) and incubate for 20 minutes on ice.
Wash the cells with 10ml of labeling buffer, centrifuge for 5 minutes at 300xg.
Resuspend them in 90μl of labeling buffer and 10μl of Streptavidin beads per 10 x10^6 cells and incubate for 20 minutes on ice.
Wash the cells with 10ml of labeling buffer.
Proceed with purification using the MACS LS column.
Place the LS column in the MACS separator.
Wash the column with labeling buffer.
Pipette 500μl of cells in the LS column allowing the suspension to run through and collect the effluent as negative fraction (this fraction is enriched for myeloid progenitors).
Wash the column with 3ml of labeling buffer.
Repeat washing step three times.
Remove the column from the MACS separator and place it in a new 15ml collection tube.
Apply 5ml of labeling buffer and firmly flush out the cells using the plunger provided to yield the CD19 positive B cell fraction.
Seed 9x10^6 PlatE cells into two 10cm dishes two days before viral transduction.
To detach PlatE cells, wash the cells once with PBS and then add 1-3ml of TrypLE select cell dissociation reagent.
After 3-5 minutes at 37°C, add PlatE medium and count the cells in the hemocytometer.
Transfect PlatE cells with 20μg of C/EBPα-ER-hCD4 plasmid using the calcium phosphate protocol.
Replace the transfection medium after 8 hours with 6 ml of fresh B cell medium per 10cm plate.
Culture the cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Collect the supernatant after 18-20 hours of culture at 37°C.
Filter the collected supernatant using a 0.45μm sterile filter.
Add 10ng/ml of IL-7 to the filtered medium.
Use 2ml of the prepared medium to infect 2X10^6 B cells per well of a 6-well plate.
Add 6 ml of fresh B cell medium to the PlatE cells.
Place the infected cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 incubator.
Collect the supernatant from the PlatE cells after 24 hours.
Use the collected supernatant to infect the B cells again.
Prepare gelatin-coated dishes for S17 stromal cells on the day of viral transduction experiment.
Inactivate S17 cells with Mitomycin C at a density of 3X10^4 cells/cm^2 onto 10cm plates.
Wash the inactivated S17 cells with PBS.
Add TrypLE select cell dissociation reagent to detach S17 cells.
Count the detached cells using a hemocytometer.
Centrifuge infected B cells from the 6-well plate at 300xg for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 10 ml of B cell medium.
Plate the resuspended B cells on the inactivated S17 cells.
Grow the cells for 4 days or until they reach confluence.
Stain the B cells with human CD4 antibody.
Sort hCD4+ transgene containing cells using a MACS column or fluorescence activated cell sorter.
Prepare gelatin-coated 12 well dishes the day before sorting.
Inactivate MEF cells with Mitomycin C and plate them at a density of 3X10^4 cells/cm^2.
Detach MEF cells by adding TrypLE select cell dissociation reagent for 3-5 minutes, then add S17/MEF medium.
Count the detached cells in a hemocytometer.
Count hCD4+ B cells after sorting and seed them on MEF feeders at a density of 25,000 cells/cm^2.
Let the seeded cells grow for two days.
Add β-estradiol at a concentration of 100nM to activate C/EBPa in B cell medium.
Collect the supernatant after 18 hours and wash cultures twice with 500 μl of PBS.
Centrifuge the supernatant/PBS mixture at 300xg for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the pellet in fresh reprogramming medium containing 2ug/ml of doxycycline.
Re-seed the cells into the original wells.
Gently replace the medium every two days.
Observe Oct4GFP positive cells under a fluorescence microscope or record by FACS starting at day 1.
Supplement the reprogramming medium with 20% KSR, 3 μM CHIR99021, and 1 μM PD0325901 after 2 days.
Observe Oct4GFP positive colonies with ES-like morphology starting at day 4.
Change the medium to reprogramming medium without doxycycline at day 8 to select transgene-independent iPS cell colonies.
